title: [Dev 3.3.0-dev-e] Nightscout synchronization issue missing from prefs
symptom: In dev version 3.3.0-dev-e (also dev c and d), the 'Synchronization' line in Nightscout prefs is missing or disappears immediately when displaying the page. This occurs with NS v1 or v3, on fresh installs or with imported parameters, and on multiple devices (Fairphone 5, Honor, Android Emulator).
cause: The issue was caused by not having Engineering Mode enabled, which is mandatory for dev builds. The thread indicates that creating the engineering_mode file resolved the issue.
fix: Create a file named 'engineering_mode' in the directory /AAPS/extra to enable Engineering Mode, which is mandatory for running dev builds.
evidence_quote: I added the file and it solved my issue.
